info.projection_precision_scope: Original Q8 weights/scales; torch.float16 storage/KV, FP32 GDN. q8-residual uses explicit group32 activation high/residual Q8 passes with FP32 scales and changed reduction order; not original FP16 arithmetic. Column MLP keeps partial outputs/host transport FP32, then sums before one FP16 cast; changed FP32 association versus full-K down, not prior-profile byte parity. Head-local GDN output also uses FP32 column partial/host transport/sum before one FP16 cast; changed FP32 association, not prior-profile byte parity.
info.mlp_down_weight_layout: bit-preserving input-column halves, original group32 scales
info.gdn_weight_layout: bit-preserved semantic Q/K/V head rows and group32 output-column halves
info.gdn_state_layout: private packed FP32 value-head halves, split convolution histories and MTP prefixes on both devices; canonical joining diagnostics only
info.mtp_draft_precision_scope: Original Q8 weights/FP16 scales and FP16 activations/KV; explicit two residual-A8 passes/FP32 activation scales and changed reduction arithmetic, not original FP16 parity. Shared vocabulary/head retain the target profile.
info.distributed_memory_scope: all_request_device_bytes is primary; all_peer_request_device_bytes is additional GDN cache. MTP backup totals already include their reported peer component.
info.scope: Target model/workspace and MTP model/selection bytes count once; target request, additional draft/request and backup bytes per slot are disjoint. Fixed fresh/reset cohorts, no PP/continuous batching/paging. Per-slot verification wall overlaps; do not sum it.
info.target_verification: native packed cohort, request-local prefix1 recovery
